author: MrTopStep
title: Keystone Charts – FAANG New Highs
text:
Keystone Charts – FAANG New Highs Posted By: MrTopStep February 26, 2018 
ECB’s Draghi: The Euro Area Economy Is Expanding Robustly; Growth Is Stronger Than Previously Expected. 
DRAGHI SAYS INFLATION HAS YET TO SHOW SUSTAINED UPWARD TREND. 
Draghi: Inflation Path Still Conditional On ECB Stimulus. 
Draghi: Possible extension of QE hasn’t been discussed. 
Draghi: Denies That There Is A Currency War. 
Pres. Trump: If It Takes Tariffs To Bring Steel Industry Back, ‘So Be It’ – RTRS. 
FAANG stocks putting in a new high up +16% as a group from the Feb 9th low. 
AAPL nearing its all-time closing high of 179.26 and up +19% from the Feb 9 low following behind AMZN and NFLX. 
David Wienke
